scope: Proposition 11.8 (Relative optimality and its equality case) of the manuscript “Bounded klt complements for Fano contractions” (preprints/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026/Bounded-klt-complements-for-Fano-contractions-September-25-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 066 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d50937326c7cb115), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 68. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every nontrivial real Abhyankar valuation Q† of L/k′, (11.4) Aθw,rel (Q† ) ≥ κ min i active Q†(Fi) bi . An active cap contributes the entry zero. If equality holds, then Q†(F) < 0 for some actual angular function F.
